# proxmox_sdn_fabric (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN fabric from `/cluster/sdn/fabrics/fabric/{fabric_id}`. Fields without a typed counterpart stay in `pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_fabric" "ospf" {
  fabric_id = proxmox_sdn_fabric.ospf.fabric_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) Fabric to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fabric identifier.
- `ip_prefix` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `redistribute` (List of String)
- `route_map_in` (String)
- `route_map_out` (String)
- `state` (String)
